independence: Personally viewed all18 native panels via view_image original after the complete source report and metadata preread, before seeing any parent visual interpretation. Sheet IOP-group titles/descriptions and candidate identity were visible. No clinical annotations, flags or gold accessed.

group_observations.observations: All three panels show longitudinal femur/tibia side profiles, individual femoral-condylar contour, and anterior patellar/extensor profile. They closely match the sagittal appearance of S2 across sampled levels. The COR description is inconsistent with local sagittal anatomy; supplied Sagittal is supported.
Six panels show sagittal longitudinal knee side profiles with anterior patellar contours and posterior structures. They agree with Sag descriptions and supplied Sagittal.

Six transverse cross-sections show distal femur/tibia and paired condyles at different levels, with anterior patella and posterior muscle/vascular profiles. Axial local anatomy agrees with AX descriptions and official Axial.

Three views show anterior, central and posterior coronal anatomy, including paired condyles, tibial plateau and femur/tibia long axes across the knee width. This agrees with COR T1 and supplied Coronal.

conclusion: All six supplied official anatomical planes agree with observed local anatomy. Candidate S5 has a misleading COR description while its official Sagittal is appropriate. Preserve source text/geometry/cache, record the description inconsistency and propose no effective plane overrides.
current_pipeline_implication: Current loader ignores descriptions and uses supplied Anatomical_Plane for categorical routing/features. No change is supported for this case; all203 full-source integrity checks and six exact cache reproductions passed.
limitations: Eighteen selected panels were visually reviewed; all203 source files were decoded and geometrically checked separately, not clinically interpreted.
No clinical diagnosis, laterality reassignment or report target changes.
Close visual correspondence of S2/S5 does not itself establish exact duplicated pixels; native hash comparison is a separate technical check.
No general rule favoring descriptions or patient-coordinate IOP across studies is justified.
